checks.tolerance_reason: Each existing cumulative value was rounded to six decimal places: at most 0.5e-6 per point or endpoint; 1e-10 extra permits floating-point summation. Averaging six rounded curves cannot increase this bound.

custody_scope: Authenticates the existing aggregate bytes and agreement with public controls. It does not reconstruct or independently authenticate private checkpoints or original per-origin calculations.
source_kind: Previously generated aggregate of cumulative daily mean QLIKE(option state) minus QLIKE(option state plus flow), stored with six decimal places. Original aggregation producer inspected but never executed in this publication refresh.
